name: Old Crab

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); member of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.species: edible (brown) crab (Cancer pagurus), large old female
rendering.limits: Crab anatomy throughout; speech by mouthpart movement with eyestalk and claw gestures. No clothing, no face added to the carapace.

gender_note.quote: an old Crab took the opportunity of saying to her daughter … “Hold your tongue, Ma!” said the young Crab
gender_note.note: Sourced (not inferred). characters/index.json lists gender 'unspecified' — reported in qa/defects/DEF-p3-appearance-201.json.

base_age_note.reason: 'Old' and a grown daughter are sourced; persona band kept for voice casting. As an animal: a big, heavy, old crab with a worn, barnacled shell.

hair.color: brick-red to rust-brown 'pie-crust' carapace, darker and duller with age, cream-yellow underside
hair.style: pie-crust scalloped shell edge, pitted and scuffed, a few barnacles and a trace of weed; wet
hair.reason: Species colouring; age marks carry the sourced 'old'.

eyes.expression: small eyes on short stalks, raised and swivelling reprovingly at her daughter

skin.tone: see hair; jointed legs rust-brown with paler joints

face.shape: front of the carapace with mouthparts below the eyestalks
features: busy working mouthparts when she lectures

build.height_note: Standing height; carapace width 18-22 cm, species-true for a big old female.
build.posture: sidles sideways; raises one black-tipped claw and wags it at her daughter while lecturing
build.scale_reference: On the bank with the shrunken Alice (SUP-003), low at her feet; larger than her daughter.

entry_state.state: on the bank with the party, wet from the pool
entry_state.quote: all dripping wet, cross, and uncomfortable

marks.description: heavy claws with black tips, one raised and wagged as she moralises
barnacles and scuffing on the carapace

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: she wears nothing; her look is the old brick-red pie-crust shell
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives her no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old matron's dress, cap and claw mitts are dropped.

pair_rule: With CHAR-young-crab: same species so they read as mother and daughter. The mother is bigger, darker (rust-brown), barnacled and duller; the daughter smaller, brighter (coral-orange) and clean-shelled.
prompt_base_en: photoreal large old edible crab on a muddy pool bank, brick-red to rust-brown pie-crust carapace pitted and scuffed with a few barnacles, wet, heavy black-tipped claws with one raised and wagging, small black eyes on raised stalks, standing side-on, natural crustacean anatomy, macro live-action film plate
